# Coldi
> Fully managed AI voice agents for fintech: outbound and inbound calling, CRM sync, compliance, and ongoing QA — without building the stack yourself.

Coldi Labs LTD. builds and operates production voice AI for Insurance Brokers, Trading Platforms, Debt Collection, and Sales Teams.
